detail.longDescription: We have all been there: the middle of a quiet meeting or prayer, and suddenly your phone rings at full volume. It is a small, recurring stress that breaks focus and invites embarrassment. I built Muffle to handle those moments for you. By setting location or prayer-based routines, your phone manages its own volume profile, so you never have to remember to unmute again. Privacy-first and fully offline. https:// play.google.com/store/apps/det ails?id=com.muffle.app # Android # Privacy # Productivity
